texts.at-0001: Round money only with round_money Always round monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.
texts.at-0002: Normalize money via to_money and round_money In ledgerly/invoice.py, convert any incoming amount with to_money() and store it rounded with round_money(); compare against ZERO from ledgerly.money rather than a literal Decimal.
texts.at-0003: Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes Reject invalid input by raising BillingError(code, detail) from ledgerly.errors with codes like "invalid_state", "invalid_quantity" and "negative_amount", passing repr() of the offending value as detail.
texts.at-0004: Guard mutations with the draft status check Mutating invoice operations must first check invoice.status != "draft" and raise BillingError("invalid_state", ...), matching the existing guard in issue_invoice.
texts.at-0005: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`).
